title: Subsequent Developments Can't Be Used To Bypass Writ Court Orders In Contempt Proceedings: Uttarakhand High Court
description: Holding that subsquent developments cannot be used to bypass orders of the writ court in contempt proceedings, the Uttarakhand High Court held the officials of State authority in contempt of an earlier order directing inclusion of a party in the tender process for a road contract. The court noted that the respondents by pleading new developments attempted to frustrate the order of writ court as well as the contempt proceedings. The petitioner participated in a tender process floated by the state
